NAME: UART verification plan
details: Blocks 16, 17, 18: garuda_uart_top, the vendored PULP apb_uart_sv behind the APB shim, three instances. Source: GARUDA-UART-SPEC-001, decisions D-21 to D-24, vendored patch 0001. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. Vendored code is covered as far as GARUDA's use reaches; the rest is waived with the reason.

NAME: A Registers
details: One window per instance (3, 4, 6). Word offsets over the 16550 byte registers. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 RBR and THR at offset 0x00 with DLAB clear
details: A read returns the byte at the head of the receive FIFO and removes it; a write puts a byte in the transmit FIFO. Bits 31:8 read 0. Spec [N-7.2], [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim (APB agent, UART agent, scoreboard). Today: tb_uart [R-1]

NAME: sb_rx
details: Every byte read equals the next byte the UART agent sent, in order.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: sb_tx
details: Every frame on tx equals the next byte written, in order.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F02 DLL and DLM at 0x00 and 0x04 with DLAB set
details: LCR bit 7 switches the two offsets to the 16-bit baud divisor. Spec [N-6.2a].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model with banked access). Today: tb_uart [R-3] [N-6.2a]

NAME: ral_access DLL DLM
details: Read-back through the bank; RBR, THR and IER unreachable while DLAB is set and unchanged afterwards.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_reg.x_dlab_offset
details: Offsets 0x00 and 0x04 read and written with DLAB 0 and 1.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F03 IER is writable and has no effect on the interrupt line
details: Offset 0x04 with DLAB clear. The upstream interrupt unit is not connected. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [N-7.5] with IRQEN 0

NAME: a_ier_no_effect
details: irq_o depends on IRQSTAT and IRQEN only.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_reg.cp_ier
details: Each IER bit set while its 16550 condition is true.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F04 FCR clears the FIFOs and IIR is read at the same offset
details: Offset 0x08. FCR bit 1 empties the receive FIFO, bit 2 the transmit FIFO; the frame already in the shifter still goes out. The trigger level bits have no effect. Spec [N-13.2a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart FCR[1], FCR[2], [N-13.2a]

NAME: sb_fifo
details: The reference model empties its FIFO on the write; later reads and frames are compared.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_fcr.x_clear_state
details: Each clear with the FIFO empty, part full and full, and with a frame in the shifter.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F05 LCR sets word length stop bits parity and DLAB
details: Offset 0x0C, read-write, reset 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_uart [R-3] [N-6.1]

NAME: ral_access LCR
details: Reset value and read-back.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F06 LSR reports the line status and a read has no side effect
details: Offset 0x14, read-only, reset 0x60. DR bit 0, PE bit 2, FE bit 3, THRE bit 5, TEMT bit 6. Bits 2 and 3 describe the byte at the head of the receive FIFO. Spec [N-6.3], [N-6.3a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [N-6.3], [N-6.3a], [N-6.3b]

NAME: sb_lsr
details: Every LSR read compared with the model's FIFO state, allowing the one pclk of staleness the specification states.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_lsr_read_no_pop
details: A read of LSR does not change the receive FIFO.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F07 MCR MSR and SCR are not implemented
details: Offsets 0x10, 0x18, 0x1C decode, read 0, ignore writes and raise no error. Spec [N-13.1], [N-13.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_uart [N-13.1], [N-13.2]

NAME: ral_access unimplemented
details: Read 0 after a write of all ones; no PSLVERR.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F08 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT bits 0 to 2 are write-1-to-clear; DMACTL bit 0 requests on receive data and bit 1 on transmit space; ID reads 0x6A5D, the instance's block number and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_uart reads ID on all three

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers on each instance.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F09 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and change nothing
details: 0x20 to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, unaligned offsets, on reads and writes.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart - one offset

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map on every access.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Each unmapped range read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F10 Word offset 4n reaches byte register n and the upper 24 bits read 0
details: The shim shifts the address by two. Requirement R-3, spec [N-6.1], [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-3]

NAME: ral_access map
details: Each of the eight registers reached at its word offset.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F11 Accesses never wait including while the wrapper is polling LSR
details: The wrapper reads LSR in idle cycles. A bus access that arrives while a poll is in flight must still complete in the same time and with the right data. Requirement R-4, spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_uart [R-4], [N-7.4]

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_poll_never_blocks
details: A bus access is never delayed or answered with the poll's data.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_uart_apb.cp_access_vs_poll
details: A bus access starting in each phase of the wrapper's poll.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F12 Reset values
details: LSR 0x60, everything else 0, tx high. Requirement R-8.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_uart [N-9.2] [N-9.3]

NAME: ral_reset
details: Register model reset test on each instance.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: B Transmit and receive
details: Spec 7.1 to 7.3, section 8.

NAME: F13 Frame format in both directions
details: Start bit, 5 to 8 data bits least significant first, optional parity, 1 or 2 stop bits. Requirement R-1.
implementation_note: Method: sim (UART agent checks every frame). Today: tb_uart [R-1] word lengths 5 to 8, 8E1, stop bit counts

NAME: sb_tx
details: The UART agent decodes every transmitted frame with the programmed format.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_fmt.x_len_parity_stop
details: Every word length with parity off, even and odd, with 1 and 2 stop bits, in each direction.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F14 Baud rate is pclk divided by the divisor
details: Within 1 percent at 115200. Requirement R-2, spec [N-7.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-2], [N-7.1] four divisors

NAME: sb_bit_period
details: The UART agent measures every bit period on tx.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_baud.cp_divisor
details: Divisor 1, 2, 134, 1084, 2169, 13020, 0xFFFF; divisor 0, which the specification does not define.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F15 The divisor changed while a frame is being sent
details: Open defect UART-3 in the vendored transmitter - a smaller divisor leaves the line stalled for up to 65536 pclk. Firmware rule today is to wait for TEMT. Either the vendor patch goes in or the rule is the specification.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: UART-3 open; the bench waits for TEMT

NAME: uart_divisor_live_test
details: Divisor lowered and raised mid-frame; time to recover measured.
implementation_note: UVM test. Planned.

NAME: F16 Transmit FIFO
details: Sixteen entries plus the shifter. THRE is set when the FIFO is empty, TEMT when the shifter is empty too. A write when the FIFO is full is not described in the specification; to be read from the RTL and written down. Spec [N-6.3b].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart TX FIFO full with 17 bytes, [N-6.3b]

NAME: sb_fifo
details: Model compare of occupancy, THRE and TEMT.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_fifo.cp_tx_level
details: Transmit FIFO empty, 1, 15, 16, and a write while full.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F17 Receive FIFO and overrun
details: Sixteen entries. A byte arriving when it is full is lost, the sixteen already held stay intact and in order, and the receiver frames the next byte correctly.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart RX FIFO full, RX overrun

NAME: sb_fifo
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_fifo.cp_rx_level
details: Receive FIFO empty, 1, 15, 16, overrun by 1 and by several.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F18 A parity error is flagged with its own byte and the byte is kept
details: LSR bit 2 while that byte is at the head; the flag does not leak to the next byte. Requirement R-7.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-7]

NAME: sb_lsr
details: Model compare of the error flags byte by byte.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_err.x_kind_position
details: Parity and framing errors on the first, a middle and the last byte of a full FIFO; two errors in a row.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F19 A framing error is flagged with its own byte
details: LSR bit 3, from vendored patch 0001. Requirement R-7, decision D-24.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-7]

NAME: sb_lsr
details: Covered with F18.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F20 Break is neither detected nor generated
details: A long low on rx arrives as one framing error and one 0x00, LSR bit 4 stays 0, and LCR bit 6 does not pull tx low. Spec [N-13.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [N-13.3]

NAME: sb_rx
details: Model compare for a break of 1, 2 and 10 frame lengths.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F21 Back-to-back frames and baud tolerance
details: Frames with no gap are received correctly, and the receiver tolerates a mismatch of at least 6 percent either way. Spec [N-8.1], [N-8.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [N-8.1], [N-8.2]

NAME: cg_uart_baud.cp_mismatch
details: Incoming baud from minus 6 to plus 6 percent in 1 percent steps, with back-to-back frames.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_rx
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F22 The line idles high out of reset in both directions
details: tx is high from reset; the rx synchroniser resets high so no start bit is seen. Requirement R-8, spec [N-9.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_uart [R-8], [N-9.3]

NAME: a_tx_idle_high
details: uart_tx_o is 1 in reset and while TEMT is set.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_no_byte_after_reset
details: The receive FIFO is empty until a start bit has been driven.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F23 A short low pulse on rx is not a byte
details: A pulse shorter than half a bit must not leave a byte or an error in the FIFO. Not stated in the specification; to be decided and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_uart_rx.cp_glitch
details: Low pulses of 1 pclk, a quarter bit and just under half a bit while idle.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: C Interrupts
details: Spec 7.5, requirement R-5.

NAME: F24 Receive data transmit empty and line error events
details: IRQSTAT bit 0 from LSR bit 0, bit 1 from LSR bit 5, bit 2 from a parity or framing error at the head. Each is cleared by writing 1, and bit 0 comes back while data remains. Spec [N-7.5], [N-7.5a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-5], [N-7.5], [N-7.5a]

NAME: sb_irqstat
details: IRQSTAT compared with the model's events at every read.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_uart_irq.x_src_en_clear
details: Each source with its enable 0 and 1; cleared with the condition still true and gone.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F25 The interrupt is a held level
details: irq_o is the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN, held until written 1 to clear; an event in the cycle of the clear is not lost. Decision D-17.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_uart [R-5] held 60 pclk

NAME: a_irq_held
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: An event in the cycle of its own clear leaves the bit set.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: D DMA
details: Spec 7.6, requirement R-6.

NAME: F26 A request per byte on receive and per space on transmit
details: DMACTL bit 0 requests while a byte waits, bit 1 while the transmit FIFO has room. The request drops for at least one pclk after each acknowledge. Spec [N-7.6], decisions D-16, D-21.
implementation_note: Method: sim (DMA request agent) + formal. Today: tb_uart [R-6], [N-7.6]

NAME: a_dma_drop
details: dma_req_o is 0 in the pclk after dma_ack_i.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: dma_req_checker
details: One beat per assertion, no stuck request.
implementation_note: tb/common/dma_req_checker.sv, bound today.

NAME: cg_uart_dma.x_dir_level
details: Receive requests with 1 and 16 bytes waiting; transmit requests with the FIFO empty and nearly full.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F27 Beats are word sized with the byte in bits 7 -0
details: Spec [N-7.6a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-6a]

NAME: sb_rx
details: The byte the DMA agent reads is compared like any other read.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F28 No request while DLAB is set
details: The wrapper keeps a shadow of LCR bit 7 and forces the request low, so a transfer can never land on the divisor. Spec [N-6.2a], [N-7.6b].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_uart [N-7.6b]

NAME: a_dma_dlab
details: dma_req_o is 0 whenever the DLAB shadow is 1, and the shadow equals LCR bit 7.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/uart/garuda_uart_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F29 Both DMACTL bits set on the one request line
details: Receive and transmit share one channel. What the request means with both bits set is not stated; to be read from the RTL and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_uart_dma.cp_both_bits
details: DMACTL 3 with data waiting and space available.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: E Three instances and the rest of the chip
details: Requirement R-9.

NAME: F30 The three instances are independent
details: No shared register, interrupt, DMA channel or line. Each reads its own block number.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_uart [R-9]

NAME: sb_isolation
details: Traffic and errors on one instance change nothing on the other two.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F31 Windows CLIC IDs and DMA channels at chip level
details: UART0 window 3, ID 17, channel 2. UART1 window 4, ID 18, channel 3. UART2 window 6, ID 19, channel 5. Pins at the pads.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + connectivity. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_uart.c, t_chip_integ.c

NAME: t_chip_uart
details: Three UARTs through the pins from C.
implementation_note: sw/chip/t_chip_uart.c, passing.

NAME: conn_uart
details: Bound assertions at the SoC top for the interrupt, request, acknowledge and pad wires of each instance.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F32 Baud rate after a clock ratio change
details: A DIVSEL change changes pclk; firmware reprograms the divisor and the link works again.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level (scenario). Today: no check.

NAME: t_chip_divsel
details: Stage 5 scenario, shared with the clock plan.
implementation_note: sw/chip. Planned.

NAME: F Clock and reset
details: Spec section 9.

NAME: F33 Single clock domain with one asynchronous input
details: rx goes through the shim's two-flop synchroniser and three more flops upstream. Requirement R-8, decision D-14.
implementation_note: Method: static (clock-domain check) + sim. Today: no check.

NAME: hal_cdc
details: rx reported as synchronised.
implementation_note: flow/2_static. To run on this block.
